title: eumachia haematocarpa
intro: Eumachia haematocarpa, commonly known as Texas buckeye, is a plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a shrub or small tree in the Sapindaceae family and is known for its toxic seeds, which should be handled with caution. The health benefits of Eumachia haematocarpa include its potential to reduce inflammation and act as an antimicrobial agent, while its therapeutic actions may include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
